title: Parcel delivered without the liveness code
description: Deliver a parcel to the front door: parcel at the door, house number visible, but no liveness code in the photo.

criteria.label: Parcel visible at the delivery door
Parcel undamaged and not exposed to weather

notes: MANUAL §9.5 "no code" expects REJECTED or HUMAN_REVIEW. Deliberately omit the sticky note from every AFTER frame. cL is required: FAIL high-confidence -> REJECTED, NOT_VISIBLE -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
